author: Blair Marnell
description:
In Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto franchise, players have been able to walk the streets while armed to the teeth without attracting attention from the non-player characters populating the world. However, the NPCs in Grand Theft Auto 6 will be considerably more preceptive than their counterparts in the earlier games. And that means packing weapons in public is going to come at a price.

According to a GTA 6 preview in The New York Times, "a player in this one cannot whip out a shotgun or a rocket launcher and walk down the street without expecting the non-player characters to call the police
title: GTA 6 NPCs Will Notice If You’re Carrying A Weapon In Public

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Hellraiser: Revival drops players into the world of Clive Barker's cult horror franchise, as developer Saber Interactive aims to bring a faithful Hellraiser experience that doesn't hold back on making you uncomfortable. GameSpot was able to go hands-on at Gamescom, and our play session with Revival definitely delivered tension and unease, as well as an exciting new gameplay element.

Hellraiser: Revival is a first-person action-horror game that puts you in the shoes of Aidan Lynch, who has made the mistake of toying with one of Hellraiser's iconic puzzle boxes, the supernatural cube designed to open a gateway to hell. Aidan's girlfriend is taken by Hellraiser's Cenobites, the torture-loving demons from a hellish dimension known as the Labyrinth. Aidan makes a pact with Hellraiser's most infamous Cenobite, Pinhead, in order to rescue his girlfriend. There's no way this deal is going to end well for him.
title: Hellraiser: Revival Goes Out Of Its Way To Ensure You’re Uncomfortable

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is following a tradition that Rockstar previously leaned into with Red Dead Redemption 2: a focus on realism. In the case of GTA 6, that means things like filling your car with gas, working out to get (or stay) fit, and eating to stay energized. Now we know another element of this hyper-focus: various methods for stealing cars.

Whereas in past games, you could just smash the window of any car to get inside and drive off with it, in GTA 6, how you commandeer a vehicle that doesn't belong to you will be based on what kind of car it is. 

For older cars, you can smash the window just as you always have, but for a quieter approach, you can instead use a slim jim, a device you've maybe seen roadside assistance services use
title: Stealing Cars In GTA 6 Is Probably More Complicated Than You Expected

author: Mark Delaney
description:
There's so much to do in GTA 6's version of Vice City, and that means there will be plenty of ways to make money in GTA 6. With the 26-minute GTA 6 deep dive on Netflix now having come and gone, we know a lot about the game, and some of the biggest insights touched on side activities that will get Lucia and Jason paid on their adventures in criminality.

Here are all the ways we know of so far that will help you make money fast in GTA 6.

Robbing stores

Of course, the Bonnie and Clyde-like pair at the center of the story, Jason and Lucia, seem to kick off their criminal enterprise with small-time stick-ups of convenience stores (as well as jewelers and other shops).
title: There’s A Lot Of Ways To Make Money In GTA 6

author: Jason Fanelli
description:
Grand Theft Auto VI. It's the most anticipated video game of the year, and possibly of all time. Netflix just aired a 27-minute extended trailer, and you've likely read multiple stories about it right here on this site since. Multiple media outlets are now talking about recent visits to Rockstar North in Scotland, and according to one source, GTA VI won't have any microtransactions at launch, and no generative AI was used in its development.

Speaking on the Kinda Funny Gamecast, Kinda Funny's Andy Cortez and Greg Miller revealed that they asked Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson about the potential for microtransactions in GTA, as well as the use of generative AI in its development. Both reported that the answer to both questions was simply "no."
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Will Have No Microtransactions Or Generative AI

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
After literal years of waiting since the game's official announcement, Rockstar has finally pulled back the curtain on Grand Theft Auto 6's gameplay. The Netflix-exclusive Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look gave us a chance to see the game's open-world activities, combat, story missions, characters, vehicles, and much more, which just makes the wait for November 19 even more excruciating. Below, we've rounded up our coverage so you can learn about whatever it is you're most interested in regarding GTA 6.

You can pet (or scold) the dog

Grand Theft Auto 6 has something for dog-lovers and dog-haters, apparently, as a button
title: GTA 6’s Big Reveal: All The Things We Learned

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
GTA 6's main characters are Jason and Lucia, and while previous trailers have shown them in some steamy scenes, their relationship will be defined by how people play, not by a strict story mandate.

Rockstar North's Rob Nelson confirmed to The New York Times that it will be up to the player if Jason and Lucia complete the story as a romantic couple or merely partners in crime. Players will need to manage the relationship by responding to texts and, like in any good relationship, making an effort.
title: GTA 6’s Jason And Lucia Aren’t Necessarily A Couple

author: Chris Compendio
description:
The Grand Theft Auto series has always been known for its provocative satire of American culture, but don't expect GTA 6 to explicitly tackle any pivotal moments in recent American history--particularly the election of President Donald Trump or the COVID-19 pandemic that shook the world.

Speaking to The New York Times, Rockstar developers said that GTA 6 would not directly address either of those flashpoints of modern American politics, with Rockstar North co-head Rob Nelson saying: “We run the risk of dating ourselves in a sort of awkward way." Nelson continues: "So we have to look at things and go, 'What is going to have a timeless sort of quality that will speak very easily to relatable sort of human folly and foibles and will be remembered as part of this time?'”

This ap
title: GTA 6 Won’t Directly Address Trump Or The COVID Pandemic

author: Blair Marnell
description:
Netflix's extended Grand Theft Auto 6 preview has arrived, and players are already dissecting the footage to glean new details about Rockstar Games' heavily anticipated sequel. So far, the response has been largely positive except in regards to the voice of Jason Duval, the game's co-leading antihero.

One of the common complaints about Jason on social media is that he's difficult to understand for some listeners. This has drawn some comparison's to Tom Hardy's nearly incompressible Bane voice in trailers for The Dark Knight Rises. It's unknown if Rockstar will take any measures to adjust Jason's voice to make it easier to comprehend--as director Christopher Nolan did for Bane in the theatrical cut--but the prevailing sentiment online isn't in favor of Jason's vocals.
title: GTA 6’s Jason Has A Case Of Bane-itis

author: Tomas Franzese
description:
Following Grand Theft Auto 6's over-the-top Netflix gameplay reveal, Rockstar Games detailed one of the game's most important systems. Building on the traditional Wanted system from previous Grand Theft Auto titles and the Honor system from Red Dead Redemption 2, GTA 6 introduces a Criminal Profile system that tracks how violently players handle their crime sprees.

The interview confirmed that the traditional Wanted system does return when you're spotted committing a crime in GTA 6. To shake off the police chasing you, Jason and Lucia may need
title: GTA 6 Has A Red Dead 2 Honor-Style System Tracking How Violent You Are

author: Steve Watts
description:
Grand Theft Auto VI has finally had its big gameplay reveal. That included more details about the story, which centers heavily on the relationship between Jason and Lucia, and how it'ss impacted by their life of crime.

"We’re trying to reflect a sort of crazy, warped version of this American state and city--we always try to do that,” Rockstar North's Rob Nelson told the New York Times. "I think this story has--if you want it--themes of hopefulness, elements of sacrifice versus selfishness, and it plays out asking questions about whether love can survive through this storm."

That relationship is front and center in the gameplay, which lets you switch seamlessly between them. Elsewhere in the report, Nelson says that the two could be lovers or simply partners in crime, and tha
title: GTA 6 Story Is About “Whether Love Can Survive Through This Storm”

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar has shared more details about its long-awaited and heavily hyped Grand Theft Auto 6, and one key piece of information is that the game's map is apparently three times bigger than Red Dead Redemption 2's. The game takes players back to Vice City, a stand-in for Miami. Players will also be able to explore the surrounding areas.

A New York Times report featuring interviews with Rockstar's developers said, "The overall map, th
title: GTA 6 Map Is 3X Bigger Than Red Dead Redemption 2’s

author: Steve Watts
description:
Grand Theft Auto 6 had its big debut on Netflix today, alongside coverage from other international outlets. That means tons of details for the anticipated game, including an estimated playtime. According to Rockstar North's Rob Nelson, his own playthrough lasted about 80 hours.

That came from an in-depth New York Times report, which detailed the immersive aspects of the game. You'll be doing all the things we saw in the trailer like robbing banks and getting into car chases, but Nelson said he wanted players to be able to really live in the world, with all that entails.

“I hope that there will be people that want to get up, have a cup of coffee, shower, get dressed, go out for a little exercise," Nelson told NYT. "Interact with some people, explore, maybe get into some trou
title: GTA 6 Playthrough Can Last Roughly 80 Hours

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's GTA games had six-star wanted levels until GTA 5 dropped it down to five, and now Rockstar is returning to its roots by going back to six with GTA 6. How fitting.

This was confirmed in the GTA 6 Netflix gameplay video today. We don't know exactly what Jason and Lucia will need to do to achieve a six-star wanted level, but it will no doubt be the worst of the worst crimes.

A logo showed in the GTA 6 trailer also suggests there will be icons for specific crimes that players commit. The full details aren't available, however, but it makes sense that Rockstar would evolve the wanted system in some form.

One of the icons, a car, disappears when Jason or Lucia hide a car in a garage, for example. Additionally, players can destroy security camera footage to avoid the cops. Also, the police will react more aggressively when you are also mor
title: GTA 6 Returns To Six-Star Wanted Levels

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The CEO of Helldivers studio Arrowhead Game Studios has commented on the upcoming launch of GTA 6, saying he's happy there will be no PC version or online mode at launch, because that will help Helldivers 2 "keep crushing it."

In a statement to press, Sham Jorjani said Rockstar makes "ridiculous, high-effort stuff, and it's awesome that games like this get made." He said he's selfishly happy that the game won't be on PC at launch, nor will there be an online mode right away.

"It means Helldivers 2 gets to keep crushing it in our own space, and is also why it won’t be the all consuming behemoth everyone’s worried about," he said.

Rockstar has confirme
title: GTA 6 Skipping PC At Launch And Having No Online Right Away Is Good, Helldivers Boss Says

author: Steve Watts
description:
Grand Theft Auto VI had its big debut on Netflix today, and as part of the opening sequence we got confirmation that there will be very good boys, by which I mean dogs, and you can interact them in a few different ways.

When exploring an apartment complex for a package pickup, Jason and Lucia come across a dog in the hallway. Jason leans over to interact, allowing you to pet the dog, as we've come to expect in video games. But two other options were also notable: Scold, and Study.

Scolding a dog is probably exactly what it sounds like, though we didn't see it in action. Maybe there's a dog behavior mechanic and scolding helps steer them right? The Study option appears borrowed from Red Dead Redemption 2, which allowed you to study wild animals. That may indicate GTA 6 will allow you to study a variety of creatures, not just dogs. A
title: You Can Pet (And Scold, You Monster) The Dog In GTA 6

author: Gabe Gurwin
description:
If you saw footage of Exterminauts come out of Gamescom this week, then you might have thought it bore some resemblance to Helldivers 2. The two games are both cooperative PvE shooters with an assortment of powerful weapons to use and creatures to battle, but the team at Behaviour Interactive believe Exterminauts stands out in several key ways.

Speaking to GameSpot at Gamescom, creative director Vincent Regimbart acknowledged that there are definitely similarities in the two games, but also a few key changes that help Exterminauts stand out.

"Our game is not war: It's work," Regimbart said. "It's a workplace that fights back. So there's a thematic differe
title: Exterminauts Devs Talk Helldivers Comparisons And How It Separates Itself

author: Ben Janca
description:
This D&D adventure offers plenty of lore for fans, but also offers a great starting point for new players.

The Dungeons & Dragons franchise continues to expand into video games with Warlock, the upcoming open world action-RPG from Invoke Studios. Following its gameplay reveal during Gamescom Opening Night Live, GameSpot had the chance to preview a hands-off demo of Warlock, which showcased plenty of dark-fantasy elements in a world filled with player choice.
title: Warlock The New D&D Action-RPG Is Not Afraid To Ditch Tradition – Preview

author: Steve Watts
description:
Sebulba only has a few minutes of screentime in the entire Star Wars prequel trilogy, but the villainous Dug made a big impact. The racer was the antagonist of little Ani (aka Anakin Skywalker aka Darth Vader) when he was but a mere Force-fueled lad on the podracing scene. But if you ask the developers behind Star Wars Galactic Racer, he got a bad rap.

At Gamescom, GameSpot asked the developers about Sebulba in regards to cheating, but Fuse Games CEO Matt Webster took exception to the characterization in defense of poor Sebulba.

"I think he would probably take issue with 'cheating,'" Webster said. "It's, you know--"

Narrative director Nat Daw chimed in, "So long as you don't get caught, it's gamesmanship."
title: Sebulba Did Nothing Wrong, Say Star Wars Galactic Racer Devs

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
When you think of Star Wars, your mind usually flashes to lightsaber battles, Mandalorians, and the unspoken horror of Ewoks. But with Star Wars: Galactic Racer, developer Fuse Games is aiming to shine a light on a sportier part of that galaxy, as players will enter the Galactic Racing League.

Speaking to GameSpot, Fuse Games CEO Matt Webster explained that Star Wars: Galactic Racer was a chance to show a different side of Star Wars. While Star Wars Episode 1: The Phantom Menace had its iconic pod-racing sequence, recent films and TV series have largely focused on more recognizable elements of the mythos. But with Galactic Racer? Fuse Games gets to explore relatively uncharted territory in the franchise and tell a story.
title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Wants To Show You What People In A Galaxy Far, Far Away Do For Fun

author: Miri Teixeira
description:
From what I saw in the State of Decay 3 preview at Gamescom this week, the long-awaited game might just have hit that perfect sweet spot--sating long-time fans' need for novelty and innovation while giving newcomers something immediately approachable to sink their teeth into. 

I haven't played State of Decay 1 or 2, and so new am I to the genre that I can't think of a single zombie survival-horror game I have played. Heading into the preview, I was nervous. Multiplayer, combat-focused games can be pretty scary unless you're already a fan--they often punish casual players or make you feel like you're letting your teammates down because you're not all able to do the same thing. Especially in a game like State of Decay 3, where the very fate of humanity seems to rest on you and your pals' shoulders, I didn't really want that kind of pressure. 

But State of D
title: Despite Being The End Of The World, State Of Decay 3 Is Surprisingly Welcoming

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Few game companies are brave enough to go head-to-head with the release of Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6, but that's exactly what publisher Devolver Digital is doing with the launch of Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed on November 19.

Billed as a "remaster of the second remake of the original monochrome action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time," Volvy's Adventure is actually almost none of those things. The original "Volvy's Adventure" doesn't exist. This isn't a remaster but an entirely new and original game. Volvy, while actually being Devolver Digital's tongue-in-cheek platformer mascot, is obviously not the most famous of "all time."

So what is Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, actually? It's a Game Boy Color-style 2D platformer coming to
title: Devolver Digital Reveals Its GTA 6 Competitor, And It’s A Remaster Of A Nonexistent Remake

author: Eddie Makuch
description: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has suggested Microsoft could make more exclusive games again, but will The Elder Scrolls 6 be among them? We still don't know, but that's the question the BBC asked Sharma at
title: Xbox CEO Plays Coy About Whether Elder Scrolls 6 Will Skip PlayStation

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Microsoft opened up preorders for its limited-edition 25th-Anniversary Xbox Series X, and within a minute, the most expensive Xbox ever sold out. While units will likely make their ways into the hands of Xbox fans with deep pockets, it looks like scalpers have also snatched up units, and as you'd expect, they're expecting to make a big payday by flogging them on sites like eBay.

A quick look at the commerce platform reveals dozens of the rare Xbox Series X consoles have been listed, with prices ranging from $2,200 all the way up to an incredibly optimistic $27,426 by one seller in Australia--likely as
title: The Most Expensive Xbox Ever Sold Out, And People Are Already Flipping It For Thousands

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: Phantom Blade Zero looks like it'll be a major highlight of the 2026 gaming calendar, as this blend of Chinese fantasy, swords, and sorcery is looking sharp. If you're looking to jump into the martial arts action of the Phantom World with a bit of style, then you can check out this new limited-edition version of the Viture Beast XR glasses when preorders open on August 27, priced at $599. Viture says they'll start shipping out on October 29, the same day that Phantom Blade Zero releases for PC and PS5.
title: Phantom Blade Zero’s New XR Glasses Actually Have Tiny Swords On Them

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
This year's Gamescom event is underway in Cologne, Germany, and now the country's president, Frank-Walter Steinmeier--speaking at the event itself--warned people to consider the downsides to gaming. He also said gaming is great and has lots of positive effects on people and society.

As reported by DPA International, he said video games have "become so ubiquitous," so it's only prudent to "discuss the downsides of this development." He said people should look at video games "objectively, honestly, and in a nuanced way."

Steinmeier pointed out how the World Health Organization has
title: Germany’s President Warns Of Downsides To Gaming, Including Games With “Extremist Ideologies”

author: Steve Watts
description:
Star Wars has been inspiring video games practically since video games have existed, but unlike the trailblazing film series, it has mostly been content to follow the leader. As a result, we've gotten all sorts of Star Wars video games molded after familiar templates, from first-person shooters to racing games. Those have been enjoyable enough, but they're very much defined as: "genre, but Star Wars." It's rare, but not unheard of, for a Star Wars game to push a genre forward with a combination of new ideas and great execution. Star Wars Zero Company is one such case.

At first glance, it's easy to underestimate Zero Company, though. By all appearances this is simply XCOM, set in the world of Star Wars. You have a similar overhead perspective, commanding a small squad of commandos in turn-based combat as they take cover, flank and maneuver, and work together to take down formidable armies. And while that isn't inaccurat
title: Zero Company Is The Rare Star Wars Game To Meaningfully Push A Genre Forward

author: Chris Compendio
description:
Actor Peter Cullen, best known as the booming voice of Optimus Prime in the Transformers franchise, has died at the age of 85. TMZ reported the news, which was corroborated by trade publications including The Hollywood Reporter. Cullen passed away peacefully in his Los Angeles home on Wednesday, according to his agent.

Beginning his career as a live-action performer and an announcer, Cullen's run voicing Optimus Prime started with the original 1980s Transformers animated show. Optimus Prime was famously killed off in the 1986 Transformers film, and backlash led to the Autobots leader being resurrected in the show in 1987.

It wasn't until 2007 with Transformers: The Game, a tie-in to the Michael Ba
title: Peter Cullen, The Voice Behind Transformers’ Optimus Prime, Has Died

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Great racing games have an x-factor that sets them apart from their peers, but you could argue that the genre hasn't meaningfully evolved over the decades. Star Wars: Galactic Racer aims to change that perception, as the new title from developer Fuse Games looks to other genres for inspiration. While it might look like a spiritual successor to 1999's Star Wars Episode 1: Pod Racer, Galactic Racer adds in some roguelite flavor and a dash of Burnout to its take on high-speed competition in a galaxy far, far away.

"Our intention was actually to move the genre forward," Fuse Games CEO Matt Webster said to GameSpot. "We've made a lot of racing games in the past, and we love racing.
title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Wants To Break Racing Games Out Of Their Comfort Zone

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Video game console price increases could be back on the menu, as the Trump administration is reportedly weighing implementing a new round of tariffs on imported computer chips.

According to Politico, the administration is considering expanding the number of tech products subject to the duties, and they could include everyday electronics that use these chips--including gaming consoles, data center servers, and laptops. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick is reportedly aiming to use these tariffs to push foreign tech companies to build manufacturing plants inside the US if they want tax relief.

While this plan hasn't been finalized and could change in the coming months, Politico's sources say that these new tariffs will be implemented slowly if they
title: If You Thought Console Prices Were Too High, Things Could Get Even Worse

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
At long last, Rockstar will lift the veil on GTA 6 today, August 27, via an "Extended Look" on Netflix. But how long will the broadcast be? Now we know.

According to an updated listing for the showcase on the Netflix app, the Extended Look event will run for 26 minutes. That's pretty significant, but it should be, given Rockstar and Netflix are calling it "extended."

This suggest it's more than a trailer but instead a proper deep dive into the world of GTA 6. That's
title: GTA 6 Netflix Trailer’s Beefy Runtime Revealed, Footage Captured On PS5

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Following the report that said Battlefield 1's Jack Lowden is circling the role of James Bond for the next 007 movie, it’s now rumored that another actor who appeared in a video game, Jack Barton, could be in the mix as well.

Pa
title: Elden Ring’s Messmer The Impaler Actor Is Reportedly In The Running To Be The Next James Bond

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Sony has already confirmed that it's headed toward an all-digital future soon, but what about Xbox and its next-gen console, Project Helix? In a new interview, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma didn't give any concrete answers about whether Project Helix will have a disc drive, instead focusing on the topic of next-gen hardware affordability.

"This next generation, we have to be thinking about efficiency and affordability alongside performance," Sharma said to the BBC. "All of the industry needs to start to innovate on affordability and efficiency. Th
title: Xbox Won’t Say If Project Helix Has A Disc Drive, But It’s Not Giving Up On Physical Games Yet

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: Ahead of today's GTA 6 Extended Preview on Netflix, developer Rockstar Games has revealed plenty of new details on the highly anticipated open-world game. In a new interview, Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson divulged how the game, similar to GTA: San Andreas, will require you to take good care of the protagonists Jason and Lucia, as the duo will need to engage in exercise, healthy eating, and relaxation if they want to stay in shape. Just like real life, but with more immediate gains.
title: GTA 6 Wants To Remind You That Looks Matter In The Influencer Hustle Of Vice City

author: Alessandro Barbosa
description:
Former President of PlayStation Studios, Shuhei Yoshida, has praised Microsoft's recently announced disc-to-digital program, writing that it is a "great move by team Xbox."

The former executive posted his opinion on the program on X with no other commentary, but it's a notable remark given how much of Yoshida's career was spent at Xbox's main competitor. That's especially true when you consider the differences in approach Microsoft and Sony seem to be taking as we march towards an all-digital future, with Sony announcing that it plans to stop PlayStation disc production for new titles from J
title: Former PlayStation Studios President Praises Xbox’s Solution To A Digital-Only Future

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The countdown to Grand Theft Auto 6 is winding down, and ahead of its launch in November, developer Rockstar Games has a new look at the game on the way. But unlike other trailers or developer previews, this one won't be dropping on YouTube first, as Netflix has an exclusive on it for several hours. If you're planning to watch--and you have a Netflix subscription--here's everything you need to know about the upcoming GTA 6 preview.

When to watch on Netflix

Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look will premiere on Netflix at the following times on August 27:

  • 3 PM ET
  • 12 PM PT
title: GTA 6 Extended Look: How To Watch, What To Expect, And More
